title: Armor Shift
description: A client-side utility to instantly cycle and swap equipped armor with sets in your inventory via a single keybind.
body:
**Armor Shift** is a client-side utility for Minecraft Forge designed to streamline gear management. It provides a seamless mechanism to instantly exchange equipped armor pieces with alternative sets located within the player's inventory, eliminating the need for manual GUI interaction during critical gameplay moments.

---

## Overview

Armor Shift eliminates the necessity of manual inventory management in the heat of action. Designed for players who demand technical efficiency and agility, the mod allows for gear transitions without ever closing the game screen or interrupting movement.

As a purely client-side modification, this mod focuses on versatility, allowing it to be used in any multiplayer environment or SMP without requiring plugins or server-side installations.

![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1539469/description_eeafb25b-db06-44e8-a122-e6623b9a8ec9.gif)

---

## Features

* **Instant Exchange**: Perform a full armor swap instantly via a single keybind without opening the inventory screen.
* **Zero Server Requests**: As a purely client-side modification, Armor Shift works on any multiplayer server or SMP without requiring server-side installation.
* **Priority-Based Selection**: Automatically finds and equips the first matching armor pieces found in your inventory, following a standard top-to-bottom scanning order.
* **Intelligent Conflict Context**: The keybind is active only when in-game and not in other menus to prevent conflicts.

---

## Configuration

The mod is configured directly through the standard Minecraft controls menu:

1. Navigate to **Options** > **Controls** > **Key Binds**.
2. Locate the **Armor Shift** category.
3. Assign a preferred key to the **Swap Armor** function (unassigned by default to prevent conflicts).

---

## Compatibility

* **Minecraft Version**: 1.20.1
* **Mod Loader**: Forge 47.4.10+
* **Side**: Client-side only
